method: A reference for the screener's ratios built without the application (K16). Inputs are read by hand from the tables of one annual report per case (statement tables in data/raw/sec-extracts; the shares outstanding from the cover page of the report's primary document, which P/B and P/S count when the report also tags a weighted average, M47), the close from the price vendor's file (data/raw/benjaminpo-v81, column Close). Amounts are USD millions, shares millions, per-share values USD, all as the report prints them. Expected ratios were calculated by hand from these inputs with the formulas of METHODOLOGY.md (Ratios) and rounded to six decimals, as the API rounds. A per-share basis is the report's: when a split falls between the report and the session, the close is multiplied by split_factor to restate it on the report's basis. `check-ratios` compares the screener on the stored database with this file; a ratio may differ by tolerance (relative) for rounding of report tables and vendor split ratios. A known difference names its finding in review-findings.md and stays listed until the finding is fixed.
